svg.desc: Software correctness, electrical timing and mechanical qualification are separate questions.
svg.text: PROTOMATE / CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION
Motion baseline: evidence and remaining limits
Software correctness, electrical timing and mechanical qualification are separate questions.
Admission and ownership
One exclusive Motor / Axis / Robot family. Reservations include
preparation and cleanup. Protocol, configuration, session, axis
revisions and positions are checked before outputs are armed.
Execution and stopping
M4 maintains immutable schedules with an installed brake.
Explicit stop and lease loss select that branch locally. Abort /
guard inhibition are separate fault paths and can invalidate
referencing.
Memory remains a constraint
Normal M4 fast code has 3,360 B free; the profiling build has
only 56 B. Raw/homing workers reuse 10 KiB stacks.
Commands have 28 KiB and the executor 8 KiB. The short IO
workflow retained at least 29% measured stack headroom.
Concurrent motion: ICC allocation fixed
Senders reuse their frame buffers. M4 admission/dispatch now run
from SDRAM after traces identified QSPI stalls. Independent-axis
overlaps and the complete buffered-raw workflow pass without
deadline or priority changes.
Startup and stopping: verified
Initial DMA calculations run with interrupts available in bounded
batches; publication rechecks cancellation/revision. Final captures
pass raw 800/800/400, coordinated 400/400/400 and early stop
266/266/266, with enable inactive.
Verification scope
Clang-tidy: 430/430 contexts, zero findings. Internal-RAM call-path
audit passes. Full host and sanitizer outcomes are recorded in the
current review. Short electrical tests do not qualify maximum-rate
endurance, powered mechanics or the physical panel.
Use the review report for exact test outcomes and capture hashes. No diagram claims that a passing short capture proves a full-rate or
mechanically safe operating envelope.
Current source • Normal Release pair: 6bb2cd35b1b7e73a • Electrical tests do not establish mechanical qualification
Sources: Controller / Ownership / StepperMotor; OperatingEnvelope; review report and hardware captures.
